title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Contents Payments Already Made
content:
Ledger rule on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the contents payments already made that reduce a new contents payment.

**Rule.** The contents payments already made that a contents payment is reduced by are settled as follows: when another claim number on the policy carries the same date of loss as a duplicate first notice, they are the contents payments issued under both claim numbers less the contents payment items voided under both; when there is no such duplicate first notice, contents payment items on the claim have been voided and no contents payment was issued on the claim after the latest void, they are all the contents payments issued on the claim, because the voided item is reissued on its own under a new payment reference; otherwise they are the contents payments issued on the claim less the contents payment items voided on it.

## Decision lines

- A second claim number for the same date of loss exists → both claim numbers' contents payments less both claim numbers' voided items.
- No duplicate; a contents item voided; no contents payment issued after the latest void (a payment the same day is not after it) → all contents payments issued on the claim.
- Otherwise → contents payments issued on the claim less voided items.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Issued 12,000.00 and 3,000.00; the 3,000.00 item voided on 2 June; nothing issued since: 15,000.00.
- Issued 12,000.00 only, nothing voided: 12,000.00.
